candidates.difference: Numbers specifies red heifer and ashes for purification from corpse impurity; Qur'an 2:69 specifies yellow and 2:71 concludes a distinct murder-investigation story, not an identical ritual.

candidates.shared: Stone/heart imagery for moral and religious resistance
candidates.difference: Ezekiel promises replacement of a stone heart with flesh; Qur'an rebukes hardened hearts and compares rocks that can split and release water.
